top_story.headline: PAC says unreported independent expenditures were already disclosed, answering FEC inquiry
top_story.dek: More Jobs, Less Government replied October 10 to a September 7 Request for Additional Information.
paragraphs: More Jobs, Less Government (treasurer Charles Gantt) — responding to a September 7 Request for Additional Information on its amended July Quarterly Report, the committee says two independent expenditures disseminated May 19 that the FEC thought were not timely reported on 24-Hour Reports were already disclosed in an amended report filed July 31, and that it separately made a self-reported (sua sponte) submission to the FEC Office of General Counsel that day, calling the omission of two small production costs inadvertent.
The letter is addressed to Aaron Carrell, Senior Campaign Finance Analyst in the FEC Reports Analysis Division, and does not state the dollar amount of the two production costs.

sections.headline: Four non-routine Form 99 statements
paragraphs: Eight new Form 99 submissions surfaced; four are below, with the three candidate-committee threshold statements listed in the next section. No new Requests for Additional Information (FRQ) appeared: all 54 in the window were already reported in earlier editions.

items: More Jobs, Less Government (PAC; treasurer Charles Gantt, c/o Bulldog Compliance) — responding to a September 7 Request for Additional Information on its amended July Quarterly Report, the committee says two independent expenditures disseminated May 19 that the FEC thought were not timely reported on 24-Hour Reports were already disclosed in an amended report filed July 31, and that it separately made a self-reported (sua sponte) submission to the FEC Office of General Counsel that day, calling the omission of two small production costs inadvertent. Filing

James Walter Legate Jr. (presidential candidate committee, San Antonio, TX) — a zero-activity statement (no receipts or disbursements) with an attached 2019 notarized affidavit in which Legate revokes any power of attorney he gave to a named person while he was detained in jail. Filing
Okies First PAC (treasurer Brayden Brumley, Oklahoma City) — the submission contains no explanatory text, only the committee header. Filing
APAC of Val Media (treasurer Rob Gomez, La Habra Heights, CA) — says it has not handled the minimum $1,000 in any period and has nothing to report. Filing

sections.headline: Three small challenger committees say they are below filing thresholds
paragraphs: None of the committees filing these Form 99 statements belongs to a sitting member of Congress; all three candidates are listed by the FEC as challengers.

items: Heimerman for Congress (Adam Heimerman, Independent, Tennessee House challenger) — says it has not received or spent enough to file detailed reports and is not seeking donations. Filing
Tracie Burke Campaign Committee (Tracie Burke, Democratic Louisiana Senate challenger) — says it has not met the $5,000 reporting threshold for the 2026 October Quarterly Report. Filing

Friends of Cousin Pat (Patrick Carney, West Virginia House challenger) — filed the same statement twice on October 9 (Filing and Filing) saying the committee has not met the $5,000 reporting threshold in the first, second or third quarter.

sections.headline: No new RFAIs
paragraphs: Every RFAI in the window was already covered in an earlier edition.

items: 10/15/2026 (4 days): FEC October Quarterly (Q3) reports due, covering activity through Sept. 30
10/15/2026 (4 days): 48-hour contribution notices (Form 6) and 24-hour independent-expenditure reports begin for the Nov. 3 general (contributions/IEs of $1,000+ from Oct. 15 through Oct. 31/Nov. 1)
10/22/2026 (11 days): FEC Pre-General (12G) reports due, covering activity through Oct. 14

sections.headline: $8,975,969 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 34 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $8,975,969 in all. Largest target: Lauren Boebert (oppose, $1,500,000). 6 spender(s) registered in the last 180 days.

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/8/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.
